answer.text: Ticks and fleas are common, especially in the monsoon. Check your pet’s coat, ears and between the toes after walks, and use a preventive your vet recommends regularly. Some ticks carry serious diseases, so tell your vet if your pet seems tired, pale or off their food after a tick bite. Your vet knows your pet and can advise for them specifically.
